title: SFBond 실버폭스 #047 · 금박 · 사지를 뒤로 당김 · 체형 hourglass bombshell · Polynesian · early 50s · 헤어 crown braid wrapping around the head
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Polynesian woman, a warm bronze-brown complexion, early 50s silver fox goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, silver-white crown braid wrapping around the head — full body applied ELECTRIC EMERALD leaf covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle, both legs FULLY covered to ankles. Thin irregular metallic sheets — BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD leaf with fine natural creases and overlapping seams across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID GOLD undertone glinting through the thinnest points, a soft warm metallic sheen filling every gap, every mark crisp and hand-made with clean defined edges. A faint streak of soot crosses her cheekbone, and a little grime darkens her fingertips and the soles of her bare feet. Her expression is a composed expression with a faint weariness in her eyes. Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a thick chain of massive black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, back and down to its own huge black iron ring bolted into the stone wall behind her at hip height on its own side. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a thick chain of massive black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, back to its own huge black iron ring set in the flagstone floor at the base of the wall behind her, all four chains pulled dead taut. Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her torso leaning forward against the pull of the chains behind her, her arms drawn back and down along her sides, her shoulders pulled back, her head bowed slightly, her bare feet flat on the flagstones, her whole body straining, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, with a little soot on the soles and toes. extra long almond holographic nails emerald gold tips.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across her from one side. A single woman fills the frame. Pattern density MAXIMUM — the pattern wraps her entire body from neck to ankle. Extreme high-gloss oil. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait. portrait 2:3 vertical.
